description_full: Lucky Strike Entertainment Corporation engages in the operation of location-based entertainment venues in the United States, Mexico, and Canada. The company operates traditional bowling locations under the AMF brand; upscale entertainment venues, lounge seating, arcades, and food and beverage under the Lucky Strike and Bowlero brands; location-based entertainment, including mily entertainment centers and water parks under the Octane Raceway, Raging Waves, Shipwreck Island, Big Kahuna's, Wet N Wild Emerald Pointe, Raging Waters Los Angeles, Castle Park, and Boomers Parks brands. It is also involved in hosting and overseeing professional and non-professional bowling tournaments, and related broadcasting activities. The company was formerly known as Bowlero Corp. and changed its name to Lucky Strike Entertainment Corporation in December 2024. Lucky Strike Entertainment Corporation was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Mechanicsville, Virginia.

financial_summary: LUCKY STRIKE ENTERTAINMENT CORP is a small-cap consumer cyclical business with a $518M market cap on $1.2B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +6% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at 7% against a 7% cost of capital, which means the business barely earns its keep economically, with gross margins sitting at 30%.
The company is burning through $10M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 6.7× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 0.8× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.
Management returns a meaningful 13.2% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 7.8% of the shares.
